vl_cache.official_code: NOT_FOUND (GitHub search 2026-11-06; VL-Cache/VL-Cache, dezhanTu/VL-Cache, tudezhan/VL-Cache: not found)
vl_cache.unofficial_repo: github.com/bhzadjnty7/Efficient-VLM-Inference commit 8705205cf05c556c43bf37aacf4bde730f150926 (notebook; defers to the paper; not used)
vl_cache.definitions: Eq.1 ThresholdFilter(A,p)_ij = A_ij if A_ij >= p*max_j A_ij else 0; p = 1%; Eq.2 gamma = #zeros/#causal; Alg.1 post-vision rows Q[m-tau:m], beta_l = clip((1-gamma_l)/Z * alpha*L, 0.01, 1)

squeezeattention.cosine: L314: cosine_similarity(layer input hidden_states, residual + self_attn output, dim=1); mean over prompt tokens
squeezeattention.groups: L527-543: KMeans(n_clusters=3) on per-layer cosine; class3 = highest centre -> budget `percent` (KV_class3); classes 1+2 share (L*ini_size - |c3|*percent)/(L-|c3|)

pyramidkv.schedule: L360-370: min_num=(cap-w)//beta; max_num=(cap-w)*2-min_num; steps=(max_num-min_num)//(L-1); capacity_l=max_num-l*steps; beta default 20
